environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in EKS pod with ephemeral filesystem. Pod spec uses a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /var/app/tenant_data. The pod's securityContext sets runAsNonRoot: true with UID 1000, and a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) is applied. Additionally, the node uses a gVisor (runsc) runtime class which intercepts all syscalls through its sentry process - critically, gVisor's path resolution in the overlay filesystem rejects any symlink or path component that would resolve outside the container's rootfs even when using relative path traversal sequences. The PostgreSQL RLS policy uses SET app.current_tenant with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on the connection role.

config.db_rls: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on app_user role
config.network_policy: egress restricted to DB service only
